title: NeuroNL2LTL：自然语言到线性时序逻辑的神经符号翻译框架
summary: 提出NeuroNL2LTL神经符号架构，结合学习翻译与形式验证。通过中间表示保证结构保持映射，利用验证结果作为强化学习奖励信号，使神经组件直接优化形式正确性。在20万+需求上实现28%语义等价，86%输出可满足，并生成上下文解释，让领域专家无需专业训练即可验证规约。
summary_en: NeuroNL2LTL is a neurosymbolic framework that unifies learned translation with formal verification for NL-to-LTL. It uses a structure-preserving intermediate representation, verifier-in-the-loop RL training, and minimal-edit repair. Achieves 28% semantic equivalence and 86% satisfiability on 200K+ requirements across 13 domains, enabling domain experts to validate specifications without specialized training.
